svg.title: SDF and fields
svg.desc: One scalar field bifurcates into occupancy and material, then recombines as editable blocks.

text.tspan: One number. Two readings. One build.

g.title: One immutable scalar field
g.desc: Field3 returns one number for each position. Geometry and material read that same value.

g.title: The zero crossing becomes occupancy
g.desc: SDF composition and displacement turn the sampled scalar into a bounded solid.

g.title: The field also drives block choice
g.desc: A field brush maps the same scalar to a palette, keeping colour aligned with the surface.

g.title: Both branches meet at fill
g.desc: The result is ordinary editable schematic data, not a separate render-only approximation.

g.aria-label: Interactive Minecraft schematic generated from the selected SDF

text.tspan: A scalar can shape geometry and material at once
Keeping both branches on the same field avoids the drift caused by unrelated noise functions.
